question: Under what physiologic state is the endogenous human analog of nesiritide produced?

options.opd: Increased circulatory volume presenting to the kidneys
options.ope: Decreased circulatory volume presenting to the kidneys

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Increased ventricular stretch -> Release of endogenous human analog of nesiritide -> 95% CHAIN: Increased ventricular stretch -> Activation of natriuretic peptide system -> Production of endogenous human analog of nesiritide -> 95%
analysis: Nesiritide is a recombinant form of human B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP), which is primarily produced in response to increased ventricular stretch.
